description: Source code for a CodeMirror mode that provides syntax highlighting and parsing for Markdown files, including support for headers, lists, blockquotes, code blocks, links, images, and inline formatting.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate CodeMirror mode based on the mode name, handling MIME types.

methods.name: blankLine
methods.description: Resets various parser states when a blank line is encountered.

methods.name: blockNormal
methods.description: Main parser function for block-level Markdown elements like headers, lists, blockquotes, code blocks, and horizontal rules.

methods.name: htmlBlock
methods.description: Handles embedded HTML blocks within Markdown.

methods.name: local
methods.description: Handles fenced code blocks with optional local modes.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the style classes for the current token based on parser state.

methods.name: inlineNormal
methods.description: Handles inline Markdown syntax such as emphasis, strong, links, images, code spans, and inline HTML.

methods.name: linkHref
methods.description: Processes the URL part of a link or image.

methods.name: getLinkHrefInside
methods.description: Returns a function to parse inside the parentheses or brackets of a link URL.

methods.name: footnoteLinkInside
methods.description: Processes the inside of footnote links.

methods.name: footnoteUrl
methods.description: Processes the URL part of a footnote link.
